fault_desc: Initial max is 0: wrong for all-negative arrays
Empty array throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, not IllegalArgumentException
Insufficient funds throws wrong exception type
Upper bound off by one: out-of-bounds for key above max
No progress: infinite loop for some missing keys
Full check off by one: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of IllegalStateException
pop does not remove the item
Boundary: quantity 10 gets no bulk discount
Boundary: subtotal exactly 100 gets no discount

Missing divisible-by-400 rule (2000 treated as non-leap)
Missing divisible-by-100 rule (1900 treated as leap)
Null returns false instead of throwing
Splits on single space only (multiple spaces, tabs miscounted)
